Definition: from G5064 and G4228; a quadruped:--fourfooted beast.
BiblicalUsage: tetrápous stands behind the English phrase a four-footed beast. In Acts 10:12, Wherein were all manner of fourfooted beasts of the earth, and it appears again in Romans 1:23.
TheologicalSignificance: A sheet full of fourfooted beasts lowered to Peter tells me God decides what is clean, and my old categories do not bind Him.
